a.speaker: narration
a.text: Santa Ana winds: hot as a hair dryer, forty miles an hour. The hills behind the studio lot have been burning since Tuesday.

b.speaker: narration
b.text: On the billboard, a gold star the size of a car. HOTSHOT CALIFORNIA. TONIGHT. 11 PM.

c.speaker: voice
c.text: The overnights came in, Miss Moreno. Thirty-one share for the motel. Your mother watched. She didn't know it was you. She liked it.

e.speaker: voice
e.text: Stage Nine. Wardrobe has your jacket. And I see makeup's already done.

f.speaker: rudy
f.text: THERE you are! Oh thank God. You're late, you're gorgeous, you're on in nineteen minutes. Is that the star? Great star. Very on brand.

h.speaker: rudy
h.text: Rudy! Floor manager! Nobody ever— okay. Listen. Security's jumpy, the sprinklers are 'decorative', and Mr. Kowalski says nobody touches his fire bars.

h2.speaker: rudy
h2.text: Break a leg. Not literally. Legal was very clear about that this week.

k.speaker: narration
k.text: Inside, under the lights, somebody has built room 204. Same bedspread. Same stain on the carpet. The cameras are already rolling.

q2.speaker: cass
q2.text: Somebody's calling the shots in there. I'd like a word.
